questions.solution_html:
• How would you set up a basic web server on Linux? List the steps. [A] / [CO1]
  • Explanation – 3 marks ..steps 2 marks
  • Steps to set up a basic web server on Linux:
  • i. Install a web server software like Apache.
  • ii. Start the web server so it begins running.
  • iii. Set it to start automatically when the computer turns on.
  • iv. Place your website files in the default web directory: /var/www/html.
  • v. Finally, open a browser and check if the server is working by typing the server's IP
  • address or http://localhost.
